name: 비나리 · 저승길 차림
quote: 무너진 도시의 흙 아래, 영원한 꽃이 피어나리라.
body_structure: 여섯 개의 팔을 가진 기괴한 인형형 인체
skin: 말라붙은 흙과 먼지가 덮인 회갈색 피부
outfit: 현대적인 테크웨어 스타일의 낡은 갈색 승복
gloves: 낡은 가죽 붕대가 감긴 여섯 개의 손
silhouette: 여섯 개의 팔이 방사형으로 뻗어 무기를 감싸고 있으며, 거대한 염주가 몸 주위를 휘감고 있는 복잡한 형태
signature_motion: 여섯 개의 팔이 동시에 염주를 휘둘러 꽃잎 폭풍을 일으킴
signature_vfx: 짙은 황토색 꽃잎들이 소용돌이치며 터져 나오는 효과
visual_en: A porcelain-fragmented mask with dull brown eyes sits atop messy earth-colored hair. Six spindly, earth-toned arms emerge from a decaying, grey-brown torso, each wrapped in weathered leather bandages. The character wears a dusty, dark brown techwear-style monk robe, heavily stained with mud. A massive, glowing ochre-colored prayer bead necklace floats around the body, partially obscuring a tattered canvas backpack adorned with dried flower petals. The feet are clad in dirty, light tan canvas sneakers. The entire silhouette is surrounded by swirling, vivid orange-brown flower petals that contrast with the heavy, dark brown textures of the limbs and clothing.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing still in a meditative posture, with all six arms symmetrically arranging the floating beads.
vfx_en: Swirling torrent of vivid ochre and burnt orange flower petals.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
